```yaml
name: GlobalLeaks Directory Refresh

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Run daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  fetch-globalleaks-data:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install requests pandas
      
      - name: Fetch GlobalLeaks data
        run: |
          python fetch_globalleaks_data.py > globalleaks_data.json

  normalize-globalleaks-data:
    needs: fetch-globalleaks-data
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install pandas
      
      - name: Normalize GlobalLeaks data
        run: |
          python normalize_globalleaks_data.py < globalleaks_data.json > normalized_globalleaks_data.json

  update-directory:
    needs: normalize-globalleaks-data
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install pandas
      
      - name: Update directory
        run: |
          python update_directory.py < normalized_globalleaks_data.json

  test-directory:
    needs: update-directory
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install pytest
      
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest test_directory.py

  deploy-directory:
    needs: test-directory
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install fabric
      
      - name: Deploy directory
        run: |
          fab deploy_directory
```
